title: Start your first Signhify project
excerpt: Create a project, write a brief, and launch your first AI-assisted run.
content: Open the dashboard, create a project with a clear title, then use New Run to describe the product outcome you want.

title: Understanding the AI Studio pipeline
excerpt: Learn what Briefing, Architecture, Design Tokens, Codegen, Review, and Deploy Plan mean.
content: Each stage converts your prompt into a more concrete product artifact, ending with a deploy-ready plan.

title: Download marketplace assets
excerpt: Free assets use signed URLs and paid assets unlock after Stripe checkout.
content: Click Download on a free listing or Buy on a paid listing. Download links expire after one hour for security.

title: Manage billing and invoices
excerpt: Use the Stripe portal to manage subscriptions, invoices, and payment methods.
content: Visit App Settings, open Billing, and click Manage subscription to enter the Stripe-hosted portal.

title: Deployments and custom domains
excerpt: Connect Cloudflare Pages deployments and add custom domains from a project workspace.
content: After a run generates deployable artifacts, use the Domains tab to add DNS records for your registrar.
